title: Fractal Tree
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Fractal
learningObjectives: Explain how a recursive function draws a branch and then calls itself to draw shorter child branches until a depth limit stops the recursion
Calculate the number of branches drawn at a given depth from the branching factor slider (2-5 branches per node)
Predict how increasing the max depth slider from 2 to 8 changes the total branch count and rendering time
Compare tree shapes produced by branch angles near 0 degrees versus 90 degrees at a fixed depth
Identify self-similarity by observing that each subtree repeats the shape of the whole tree at a smaller scale
